body:
Connect the programme's marginal and moment results in one analytical candidate. For every alpha<1/2, a bounded Fourier correction of the balanced critical tilt gives exactly uniform marginals through floor(L^alpha), any fixed density floor below one and the exact critical norm cap2^(1/s), while both leading transfer eigenvalues tend to one. The candidate also proves convergence to the product-noise spectrum when critical-power uniform integrability is added, and records the simpler strict-exponent estimate.

The coefficient-erasure method is classical and credited to primary sources. The proposed addition is the joint exact-marginal/critical-budget/spectral construction; external priority remains unestablished. No Perron-stationary marginal matching, linear-order guarantee, physical gap or continuum conclusion is claimed. This is grouped research for a later manuscript revision, not a separate paper or an inherited PDF assessment.

Three text files only. Full analytical proof, fixed12-item attack list and targeted literature scope are included. No executable mathematics, Lean or numerical test was run. Source review and required CI remain pending; no prior result, judge, PR29 or current318 PDF was changed. Preserve the exact source commit by normal merge after review, never squash or rebase.
